about:
McGinley Innovations operates the McGinley Clinic in Casper, Wyoming. The clinic was founded by Dr. Joseph C. McGinley, a musculoskeletal intervention and sports medicine physician, though the exact founding year is not stated. The organization began with a focus on redefining medicine through continuous research, problem solving, and evidence-based practice.

The clinic specializes in the treatment of sports-related injuries and musculoskeletal issues using advanced, office-based interventions. Its services include platelet-rich plasma (PRP) therapy, stem cell treatments, extracorporeal shockwave therapy (ESWT), and patented MVP and arm pump treatments using botulinum toxin. It also runs an annual physician training course covering image-guided procedures and emerging topics in musculoskeletal intervention.

The primary customers are athletes and patients seeking non-surgical solutions for conditions such as chronic exertional compartment syndrome, carpal tunnel syndrome, and arm pump. Additionally, the clinic serves physicians through its education division, which provides hands-on training to expand clinical skills.

The company states its differentiation lies in integrating cutting-edge technologies with a patient-centered, problem-solving approach, aiming to deliver time- and cost-effective care that strengthens medical practices.
